Tools & library

TOOLS
LIBRARY

📚 Library

Stored on this device only — add them once per device. PDFs open here; other file types open in whichever app the device uses for them.

💾 Storage & photos

Photos are almost all of a register's size. This shows where the space goes and can shrink them.
SHRINK PHOTOS
Re-saves every photo at a smaller size. Check the sample below first — panel labels and model numbers must stay readable. This cannot be undone except by restoring a backup.
HIDDEN DATA
An old upgrade copied some site details into fields this app can no longer show or edit. You have never seen them, but they are in every backup and every copy you send. Removing them does not touch anything you can see — your sites, contacts, equipment, test records and defects all stay. A backup is taken first.

📁 File

One file holds everything — clients, sites, plans, tests and photos. Save after changes; share via OneDrive. Backups live in ⚙ Settings.
WHERE THIS REGISTER LIVES
The one shared copy. Everyone opens and saves the same file.
KEEP A COPY
Copies do not sync back. Use them for working with no internet, or to hand a colleague a file.

Plans and files

Tabs on the left strip
Untick a trade you never work in and its tab goes, along with its symbols. Nothing is deleted — tick it back any time, and plans that already use those symbols still draw them.
Keyboard shortcuts (PC)
DL line · AR arrow · RE rectangle · EL ellipse · CD cloud · TX text · PE pen · HL highlighter · HT hatch · MV select · PA pan · TS test mode · TR trim / extend · DI measure · PN pin · RO rotate 90° · CO duplicate · AL align · GP / UG group / ungroup · FH / FV flip · SS select same · Shift while drawing = 0/45/90° only; Shift while moving = horizontal, vertical or 45° · press a tool again, or Esc, to put it down · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo / redo
Line tools: Chain joins each new line to the last, and lines snap to nearby ends, middles and crossings (turn that off in ⚙). Trim / Extend and Crop plan are in the Modify tab — Crop draws a box or an outline round the part of the plan you want and keeps your drawing with it.

Business & tax

Your own business details. They travel inside the register file and appear on the documents this app produces. Nothing here is sent anywhere.
Business
Payment details
These print on your invoices so a customer knows where to pay. Leave them blank and the payment block is left off the document entirely.
Tax
While this is off, no tax is worked out or shown anywhere, and documents are titled Invoice rather than Tax invoice.
Tax codes are yours, not ours — nothing is filled in for you. A code is a name your accounting system knows, such as GST_ON_INCOME. Rates are stored as whole basis points, so ten per cent is stored as 1000 and can never become a rounding error.
Code used on new documents
Printed in words on every document, because it is the most misread number on one.
Quotes
A quote is valid for
Days. Printed on every quote as “Valid until”. Frozen when the quote is sent, so changing this cannot expire a quote a customer is already holding.
Terms printed on every quote
One line each. Written from what Australian trade businesses commonly put on a quote — a starting point, not legal advice. Read it once and make it yours. The payment line and the Australian Consumer Law line are added automatically: the first so it always matches your invoice terms, the second because a term that tries to exclude those rights is void. Frozen when a quote is sent.
Accounting package
Switchover date
Payments recorded here BEFORE this date stay here, frozen as history — readable for ever, never edited again. Your accounting package owns everything from that day on. Nothing is migrated and nothing is duplicated, so there is no second copy to reconcile.
